description_en: Obtains all Prometheus instances in a region
kebab_example: aliyun arms list-prometheus-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --show-global-view true --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPrometheusInstances

parameters.help_en:
The cluster type. If you do not specify this parameter, all cluster types are queried. Valid values:

cloud-product-prometheus: Prometheus instance for cloud services

ManagedKubernetes: ACK managed cluster

satellite: Prometheus instance for ARMS OpenTelemetry

Ask: ACK Serverless cluster

remote-write-prometheus: general-purpose Prometheus instance

cloud-monitor-cmee: Hybrid Cloud Monitoring

ExternalKubernetes: external Kubernetes cluster registered in ACK

vpc-prometheus: Prometheus instance for ECS

cloud-monitor-direct: cloud service self-monitoring

Edge Kubernetes: ACK Edge cluster
parameters.help_zh:
可选实例类型（若不填则为查询所有类型的实例）：
cloud-product-prometheus （Region级云服务旧版）
ManagedKubernetes （容器服务ACK托管版类型）
satellite （Prometheus for ARMS OpenTelemetry）
Ask （容器服务ACK Serverless集群类型）
remote-write-prometheus （通用实例）
cloud-monitor-cmee （企业云监控）
ExternalKubernetes （容器服务注册集群类型）
vpc-prometheus （Prometheus for ECS）
cloud-monitor-direct （云服务自监控）
Edge Kubernetes （容器服务Edge集群类型）
parameters.name: cluster_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to obtain global aggregation instances. Valid values:

true

false
parameters.help_zh:
是否获取GlobalView聚合实例：
true：获取
false：不获取
parameters.name: show_global_view

schema.description_en: The information about the array object

Data.description_en: The Prometheus instances in the region in the JSON format
